title: Key Highlights: Maldives Country Climate and Development Report
temporal_coverage: World Bank CCDR highlights updated 2024; includes projections to mid-century and 2100.
methodology: Official World Bank summary of the Maldives CCDR findings and recommendations.
limitations: The linked full CCDR PDF returned 403; claims are limited to passages on the official highlights page.

title: Maldives Country Environmental Analysis: Towards a More Sustainable and Resilient Blue Economy
temporal_coverage: Country Environmental Analysis published in 2024; includes current environmental analysis and prospective policy recommendations.
methodology: Official World Bank page presenting CEA findings and recommendations on natural resource management and the blue economy.
limitations: The linked full PDF could not be retrieved by the browser; only the substantive official publisher summary was used.

title: Maldives' Third Nationally Determined Contribution: National Climate Action Plan Towards Resilience and Low-Carbon Development
organization: Ministry of Tourism and Environment, Government of Maldives
temporal_coverage: NDC3 submitted in February 2025; national climate assessment and action planning to 2035.
methodology: Government NDC presenting climate context, consultation, adaptation priorities, and planned mitigation and resilience actions.
limitations: The NDC is a policy submission, not an evaluation of outcomes; the inspected passages identify risks but do not provide island-level estimates.

title: Common Country Analysis 2024
organization: United Nations Resident Coordinator Office, Maldives
temporal_coverage: UN Country Analysis 2024, including climate projections, 2024 social context and historical island water shortages.
methodology: UNCT input, risk-matrix survey, desk review and statistics.
limitations: Geographic and demographic data gaps; evidence dates vary.

title: Common Country Analysis Maldives (January 2021)
temporal_coverage: UN CCA prepared/endorsed in January 2021; cited climate, water and gender evidence includes earlier years.
methodology: UN system collective country assessment drawing on national and UN data, sector reports and cited studies.
limitations: Historical national-level analysis; the conditional food-scarcity and sexual-exploitation risk is not an incident estimate.

title: Strengthening National and Subnational Capacity for Sustainable Disaster Risk Reduction, Climate Change Adaptation and Mitigation in Maldives
organization: United Nations Economic and Social Commission for Asia and the Pacific (ESCAP)
temporal_coverage: Climate hazard and sector exposure projections through 2060, with current risk-planning recommendations.
methodology: ESCAP overlays downscaled projections with population, agriculture, infrastructure and land-use layers.
limitations: Model, population, land-use and infrastructure data have stated gaps.

title: Disaster Statistics of Maldives 2024
organization: National Disaster Management Authority, Government of Maldives
temporal_coverage: NDMA incident collection from December 2023 through December 2024.
methodology: NDMA incident reports and recorded government relief/recovery assistance, disaggregated by hazard, atoll and island.
limitations: Report notes uneven remote-island reporting, no consistent affected-person disaggregation, and no systematic aid-effectiveness monitoring.

title: Enhancing Climate Resilience and Food Security Project (ECRFS Project)
organization: Ministry of Climate Change, Environment and Energy, Government of Maldives
temporal_coverage: Ongoing project, 2025-2030; page reports activities through October 2026.
methodology: Government project page summarizing design, site locations and project-reported implementation updates.
limitations: Activities and outputs are project-reported; project objectives and expected outcomes are not evaluated impacts.

title: CRM in Maldives: Strengthening synergies and alignment of DRR and climate action
organization: United Nations Office for Disaster Risk Reduction (UNDRR)
temporal_coverage: Technical assistance and capacity development completed during 2022-2024; case study published September 2025.
methodology: UNDRR case study summarizing government and partner technical-assistance activities and reported strategy outputs.
limitations: Institutional case study, not an independent evaluation of strategy implementation or subnational outcomes.
